sources.summary: Koto's new Niwa flatpack collection is an evolution of our commitment to thoughtful, sustainable modular design. Born from a desire to create adaptable, nature-connected spaces in even the most remote locations, Niwa represents a blend of precision craftsmanship, sustainability, and effortless assembly. Inspired by Scandinavian and Japanese design philosophies, Niwa cabins are sculptural in their simplicity - spaces that serve as tranquil sanctuaries rather than just structures. The Niwa concept was developed in response to increasing demand for Koto's signature aesthetic in hard-to-reach places. We saw an opportunity to reimagine our modular architecture in a way that prioritized ease of transport, efficiency, and flexibility without sacrificing the integrity of the design. The result is a cabin that arrives in a panelised form, allowing for effortless shipping and assembly, making high-quality prefabrication more accessible than ever.
